---
name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't work, looks wrong or sounds wrong
title: ''
labels: bug
---

**What happened** (and what you expected):

**Where in the game** (area / cutscene / menu; a checkpoint from F6 helps a lot):

**How often:** always / sometimes / once

**Your PC:** Windows version, CPU, GPU + driver version, monitor refresh rate, resolution scale and frame-rate cap (F1 menu)

**Attach these files** from your install folder (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\GoW2-Windows` unless you changed it):
- `gow2.log` (the last run; `gow2.prev.log` is the run before)
- `build.log` if the build failed
- a screenshot or short video if it's visual

Please do not attach game files (EBOOT, .psarc, .pkg, .rap, saves): they can't be shared.
